description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractJsonFieldDefinition' that implements the 'JsonFieldDefinition' interface. It provides a basis for defining JSON field mappings, including pointer location, type checking, value transformation, and associated markers. The class manages JSON pointers, type validation, and value mapping for JSON parsing and processing within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: AbstractJsonFieldDefinition
classes.description: An abstract class providing a framework for JSON field definitions, supporting type safety, markers, and value mapping for JSON parsing within the Eclipse Ditto project.

methods.name: getPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer indicating the location of this field within the JSON structure.

methods.name: getValueType
methods.description: Returns the Java class type of the value this field definition handles.

methods.name: getMarkers
methods.description: Returns the set of markers associated with this JSON field, representing additional semantics.

methods.name: isMarkedAs
methods.description: Checks if the field is marked with specified markers.

methods.name: mapValue
methods.description: Converts a JsonValue to its Java type using the provided mapping function after validation.
